sanskrit: tatra vedavido rājaṃś cakruḥ karmāṇi yājakāḥ parikramantaḥ śāstrajñā vidhivat sādhuśikṣitāḥ
english: There, O king, the officiating priests, versed in the Vedas, knowers of the sacred science and well trained, moving about in their circuits, performed the rites according to ordinance.

sanskrit: na teṣāṃ skhalitaṃ tatra nāsīd apahutaṃ tathā kramayuktaṃ ca yuktaṃ ca cakrus tatra dvijarṣabhāḥ
english: Among them there was no stumbling nor any wrong oblation; those bulls among the twice-born performed every act there in due sequence and with precision.

sanskrit: kṛtvā pravargyaṃ dharmajñā yathāvad dvijasattamāḥ cakrus te vidhivad rājaṃs tathaivābhiṣavaṃ dvijāḥ
english: Having duly performed the Pravargya rite, those best of the twice-born, knowers of the law, then, O king, carried out the pressing of the Soma according to ordinance.

sanskrit: abhiṣūya tato rājan somaṃ somapasattamāḥ savanāny ānupūrvyeṇa cakruḥ śāstrānusāriṇaḥ
english: Having pressed the Soma, O king, those foremost of Soma-drinkers, following the scriptures, performed the pressings one after another in their proper order.

sanskrit: na tatra kṛpaṇaḥ kaś cin na daridro babhūva ha kṣudhito duḥkhito vāpi prākṛto vāpi mānavaḥ
english: There was not there a single wretched man, nor a poor one, nor any hungry, sorrowful, or lowly person.

sanskrit: bhojanaṃ bhojanārthibhyo dāpayām āsa nityadā bhīmaseno mahātejāḥ satataṃ rājaśāsanāt
english: Bhīmasena of great splendour, at the king's constant command, had food given out without ceasing to all who sought to eat.

sanskrit: saṃstare kuśalāś cāpi sarvakarmāṇi yājakāḥ divase divase cakrur yathāśāstrārthacakṣuṣaḥ
english: Skilled too in the laying of the sacrificial grass, the priests, their eyes fixed on the meaning of the scriptures, performed all the rites day after day.

sanskrit: nāṣaḍaṅgavid atrāsīt sadasyas tasya dhīmataḥ nāvrato nānupādhyāyo na ca vādākṣamo dvijaḥ
english: Not one of that wise king's assembled members was ignorant of the six auxiliary sciences; none was without his vows, without a teacher, or unequal to debate.

sanskrit: tato yūpocchraye prāpte ṣaḍ bailvān bharatarṣabha khādirān bilvasamitāṃs tāvataḥ sarvavarṇinaḥ
english: Then, O bull of the Bhāratas, when the time came for raising the sacrificial posts, they set up six of bilva wood, as many of khadira, and the same number wrought of bilva timber, of every kind.

sanskrit: devadārumayau dvau tu yūpau kurupateḥ kratau śleṣmātakamayaṃ caikaṃ yājakāḥ samakārayan
english: In the sacrifice of the lord of the Kurus the priests caused to be made two posts of devadāru wood and one of śleṣmātaka.

sanskrit: śobhārthaṃ cāparān yūpān kāñcanān puruṣarṣabha sa bhīmaḥ kārayām āsa dharmarājasya śāsanāt
english: And for splendour's sake, O bull among men, Bhīma had other posts made of gold, at the command of the Dharma-king.

sanskrit: te vyarājanta rājarṣe vāsobhir upaśobhitāḥ narendrābhigatā devān yathā saptarṣayo divi
english: Adorned with cloths, O royal sage, those posts shone forth, attended by lords of men, like the seven sages waiting upon the gods in heaven.

sanskrit: iṣṭakāḥ kāñcanīś cātra cayanārthaṃ kṛtābhavan śuśubhe cayanaṃ tatra dakṣasyeva prajāpateḥ
english: There bricks of gold too were made for the building of the fire-altar, and the altar shone there as had that of Dakṣa, lord of creatures.

sanskrit: catuścityaḥ sa tasyāsīd aṣṭādaśakarātmakaḥ sa rukmapakṣo nicitas triguṇo garuḍākṛtiḥ
english: His altar was built of four layers and measured eighteen cubits; piled with golden wings, threefold in size, it had the shape of Garuḍa.

sanskrit: tato niyuktāḥ paśavo yathāśāstraṃ manīṣibhiḥ taṃ taṃ devaṃ samuddiśya pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaś ca ye
english: Then the sacrificial victims were appointed by the wise according to the scriptures, the birds and the beasts, each dedicated to its own particular deity.

sanskrit: ṛṣabhāḥ śāstrapaṭhitās tathā jalacarāś ca ye sarvāṃs tān abhyayuñjaṃs te tatrāgnicayakarmaṇi
english: Bulls prescribed by the scriptures, and such creatures as dwell in the waters — all of these they yoked there to the rite of the building of the fire.

sanskrit: yūpeṣu niyataṃ cāsīt paśūnāṃ triśataṃ tathā aśvaratnottaraṃ rājñaḥ kaunteyasya mahātmanaḥ
english: At the posts there were appointed three hundred beasts in all, with the jewel of a horse foremost among them, for the great-souled king, son of Kuntī.

sanskrit: sa yajñaḥ śuśubhe tasya sākṣād devarṣisaṃkulaḥ gandharvagaṇasaṃkīrṇaḥ śobhito 'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
english: That sacrifice of his shone forth, thronged in person with divine sages, crowded with hosts of Gandharvas, and graced by troops of Apsarases.

sanskrit: sa kiṃpuruṣagītaiś ca kiṃnarair upaśobhitaḥ siddhavipranivāsaiś ca samantād abhisaṃvṛtaḥ
english: It was made beautiful by the songs of Kiṃpuruṣas and by Kinnaras, and encompassed on every side by the dwellings of Siddhas and brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: tasmin sadasi nityās tu vyāsaśiṣyā dvijottamāḥ sarvaśāstrapraṇetāraḥ kuśalā yajñakarmasu
english: Ever present in that assembly were the disciples of Vyāsa, foremost of the twice-born, authors of all the scriptures and skilled in the works of sacrifice.

sanskrit: nāradaś ca babhūvātra tumburuś ca mahādyutiḥ viśvāvasuś citrasenas tathānye gītakovidāḥ
english: And there were present Nārada and Tumburu of great lustre, Viśvāvasu, Citrasena, and others skilled in song.

sanskrit: gandharvā gītakuśalā nṛtteṣu ca viśāradāḥ ramayanti sma tān viprān yajñakarmāntareṣv atha
english: The Gandharvas, skilled in song and accomplished in dance, delighted those brāhmaṇas in the intervals between the rites of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śamayitvā paśūn anyān vidhivad dvijasattamāḥ turagaṃ taṃ yathāśāstram ālabhanta dvijātayaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having dispatched the other victims according to ordinance, those best of the twice-born, the brāhmaṇas, seized the horse in the manner the scriptures prescribe.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃjñāpya turagaṃ vidhivad yājakarṣabhāḥ upasaṃveśayan rājaṃs tatas tāṃ drupadātmajām kalābhis tisṛbhī rājan yathāvidhi manasvinīm
english: Then, O king, having duly quieted the horse, those bulls among priests had the high-minded daughter of Drupada lie down beside it, with the three portions performed according to rule.

sanskrit: uddhṛtya tu vapāṃ tasya yathāśāstraṃ dvijarṣabhāḥ śrapayām āsur avyagrāḥ śāstravad bharatarṣabha
english: Drawing out its omentum according to the scriptures, O bull of the Bhāratas, those bulls among the twice-born, unhurried, cooked it as the scriptures direct.

sanskrit: taṃ vapādhūmagandhaṃ tu dharmarājaḥ sahānujaḥ upājighrad yathānyāyaṃ sarvapāpmāpahaṃ tadā
english: And the Dharma-king, together with his younger brothers, then inhaled in due form that smoke-scent of the omentum, which takes away all sin.

sanskrit: śiṣṭāny aṅgāni yāny āsaṃs tasyāśvasya narādhipa tāny agnau juhuvur dhīrāḥ samastāḥ ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ
english: Whatever limbs of that horse remained, O lord of men, the steadfast sixteen officiating priests, all together, offered into the fire.

sanskrit: saṃsthāpyaivaṃ tasya rājñas taṃ kratuṃ śakratejasaḥ vyāsaḥ saśiṣyo bhagavān vardhayām āsa taṃ nṛpam
english: Having thus brought to completion the sacrifice of that king of Indra-like splendour, the blessed Vyāsa, with his disciples, exalted that monarch with benedictions.

sanskrit: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prādāt sadasyebhyo yathāvidhi koṭīsahasraṃ niṣkāṇāṃ vyāsāya tu vasuṃdharām
english: Then Yudhiṣṭhira gave, according to ordinance, a thousand crores of gold coins to the assembled members, and to Vyāsa he gave the earth itself.

sanskrit: pratigṛhya dharāṃ rājan vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ abravīd bharataśreṣṭhaṃ dharmātmānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Having accepted the earth, O king, Vyāsa the son of Satyavatī addressed the best of the Bhāratas, the righteous-souled Yudhiṣṭhira:

sanskrit: pṛthivī bhavatas tv eṣā saṃnyastā rājasattama niṣkrayo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ brāhmaṇā hi dhanārthinaḥ
english: "This earth, O best of kings, which you have bestowed, is yours again; let a redemption-price be given to me instead, for brāhmaṇas are seekers of wealth."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiras tu tān viprān pratyuvāca mahāmanāḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito dhīmān madhye rājñāṃ mahātmanām
english: Then the great-minded and wise Yudhiṣṭhira, in the midst of high-souled kings and together with his brothers, replied to those brāhmaṇas:

sanskrit: aśvamedhe mahāyajñe pṛthivī dakṣiṇā smṛtā arjunena jitā seyam ṛtvigbhyaḥ prāpitā mayā
english: "In the great horse-sacrifice the earth is declared to be the priestly fee; this earth, won by Arjuna, has been delivered by me to the officiating priests.

sanskrit: vanaṃ pravekṣye viprendrā vibhajadhvaṃ mahīm imām caturdhā pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā cāturhotrapramāṇataḥ
english: I shall enter the forest, O lords among brāhmaṇas; divide this earth among yourselves, making the earth into four parts according to the measure of the four classes of priests.

sanskrit: nāham ādātum icchāmi brahmasvaṃ munisattamāḥ idaṃ hi me mataṃ nityaṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mamānaghāḥ
english: I have no wish to take back what is now the brāhmaṇas' wealth, O best of sages; this is ever my judgement and that of my brothers, O sinless ones."

sanskrit: ity uktavati tasmiṃs te bhrātaro draupadī ca sā evam etad iti prāhus tad abhūd romaharṣaṇam
english: When he had spoken thus, his brothers and Draupadī said, "So be it indeed"; and that was a thing that made the hair stand on end.

sanskrit: tato 'ntarikṣe vāg āsīt sādhu sādhv iti bhārata tathaiva dvijasaṃghānāṃ śaṃsatāṃ vibabhau svanaḥ
english: Then there came a voice from the sky, O Bhārata, crying "Well done, well done!"; and likewise rose the sound of the assembled brāhmaṇas in praise.

sanskrit: dvaipāyanas tathoktas tu punar eva yudhiṣṭhiram uvāca madhye viprāṇām idaṃ saṃpūjayan muniḥ
english: Dvaipāyana, thus addressed, spoke again to Yudhiṣṭhira; in the midst of the brāhmaṇas the sage said this, honouring him:

sanskrit: dattaiṣā bhavatā mahyaṃ tāṃ te pratidadāmy aham hiraṇyaṃ dīyatām ebhyo dvijātibhyo dharās tu te
english: "This earth has been given by you to me; I give it back to you. Let gold be given to these twice-born ones, but let the earth be yours."

sanskrit: tato 'bravīd vāsudevo dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram yathāha bhagavān vyāsas tathā tat kartum arhasi
english: Then Vāsudeva said to the Dharma-king Yudhiṣṭhira: "As the blessed Vyāsa has spoken, so you ought to do."

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ sa kuruśreṣṭhaḥ prītātmā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha koṭikoṭikṛtāṃ prādād dakṣiṇāṃ triguṇāṃ kratoḥ
english: Thus addressed, that best of the Kurus, glad of heart, together with his brothers gave as the sacrificial fee threefold crores upon crores.

sanskrit: na kariṣyati tal loke kaś cid anyo narādhipaḥ yat kṛtaṃ kurusiṃhena maruttasyānukurvatā
english: No other king in the world will do what was done by that lion of the Kurus, who was emulating Marutta.

sanskrit: pratigṛhya tu tad dravyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ ṛtvigbhyaḥ pradadau vidvāṃś caturdhā vyabhajaṃś ca te
english: Having accepted that wealth, the mighty and learned Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana gave it to the officiating priests, and they divided it into four parts.

sanskrit: pṛthivyā niṣkrayaṃ dattvā tad dhiraṇyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ dhūtapāpmā jitasvargo mumude bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
english: Having given that gold as the redemption-price of the earth, Yudhiṣṭhira, his sins shaken off and heaven won, rejoiced together with his brothers.

sanskrit: ṛtvijas tam aparyantaṃ suvarṇanicayaṃ tadā vyabhajanta dvijātibhyo yathotsāhaṃ yathābalam
english: The officiating priests then distributed that boundless heap of gold among the twice-born, according to each one's zeal and according to his strength.

sanskrit: yajñavāṭe tu yat kiṃ cid dhiraṇyam api bhūṣaṇam toraṇāni ca yūpāṃś ca ghaṭāḥ pātrīs tatheṣṭakāḥ yudhiṣṭhirābhyanujñātāḥ sarvaṃ tad vyabhajan dvijāḥ
english: And whatever gold or ornament there was in the sacrificial enclosure — the archways, the posts, the pots, the vessels, and the bricks — all of it the brāhmaṇas, with Yudhiṣṭhira's leave, divided among themselves.

sanskrit: anantaraṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ kṣatriyā jahrire vasu tathā viṭśūdrasaṃghāś ca tathānye mlecchajātayaḥ kālena mahatā jahrus tat suvarṇaṃ tatas tataḥ
english: After the brāhmaṇas, the kṣatriyas took away wealth, and so too the throngs of vaiśyas and śūdras, and others of the barbarian tribes; over a long time they carried off that gold from here and there.

sanskrit: tatas te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve muditā jagmur ālayān tarpitā vasunā tena dharmarājñā mahātmanā
english: Then all those brāhmaṇas, gladdened and satisfied with that wealth by the great-souled Dharma-king, went away to their dwellings.

sanskrit: svam aṃśaṃ bhagavān vyāsaḥ kuntyai pādābhivādanāt pradadau tasya mahato hiraṇyasya mahādyutiḥ
english: The blessed Vyāsa of great lustre, in return for the homage paid to his feet, gave his own share of that great store of gold to Kuntī.

sanskrit: śvaśurāt prītidāyaṃ taṃ prāpya sā prītamānasā cakāra puṇyaṃ loke tu sumahāntaṃ pṛthā tadā
english: Having received that gift of affection from her father-in-law, Pṛthā, glad of heart, then performed a very great act of merit in the world.

sanskrit: gatvā tv avabhṛthaṃ rājā vipāpmā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha sabhājyamānaḥ śuśubhe mahendro daivatair iva
english: Having gone to the concluding ablution, the king, freed of sin and together with his brothers, shone forth, honoured all around, like great Indra among the gods.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavāś ca mahīpālaiḥ sametaiḥ saṃvṛtās tadā aśobhanta mahārāja grahās tārāgaṇair iva
english: And the Pāṇḍavas, surrounded then by assembled kings, shone, O great king, like the planets amid the host of stars.

sanskrit: rājabhyo 'pi tataḥ prādād ratnāni vividhāni ca gajān aśvān alaṃkārān striyo vastrāṇi kāñcanam
english: Then to the kings as well he gave jewels of many kinds, elephants, horses, ornaments, women, garments, and gold.

sanskrit: tad dhanaugham aparyantaṃ pārthaḥ pārthivamaṇḍale visṛjañ śuśubhe rājā yathā vaiśravaṇas tathā
english: Pouring out that boundless flood of wealth upon the circle of kings, the royal son of Pṛthā shone as does Vaiśravaṇa, the lord of riches.

sanskrit: ānāyya ca tathā vīraṃ rājānaṃ babhruvāhanam pradāya vipulaṃ vittaṃ gṛhān prāsthāpayat tadā
english: And having summoned the heroic king Babhruvāhana and bestowed on him abundant wealth, he then sent him home.

sanskrit: duḥśalāyāś ca taṃ pautraṃ bālakaṃ pārthivarṣabha svarājye pitṛbhir gupte prītyā samabhiṣecayat
english: And, O bull among kings, he lovingly consecrated the young grandson of Duḥśalā in his own kingdom, which had been guarded by his forefathers.

sanskrit: rājñaś caivāpi tān sarvān suvibhaktān supūjitān prasthāpayām āsa vaśī kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: And the self-controlled Yudhiṣṭhira, king of the Kurus, having well rewarded and duly honoured all those kings, sent them on their way.

sanskrit: evaṃ babhūva yajñaḥ sa dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ bahvannadhanaratnaughaḥ surāmaireyasāgaraḥ
english: Thus was that sacrifice of the wise Dharma-king — a flood of plentiful food, wealth, and jewels, an ocean of wine and spirituous liquor.

sanskrit: sarpiḥpaṅkā hradā yatra bahavaś cānnaparvatāḥ rasālākardamāḥ kulyā babhūvur bharatarṣabha
english: There, O bull of the Bhāratas, were lakes whose mire was clarified butter and many mountains of food, and streams whose mud was sweet rasālā.

sanskrit: bhakṣyaṣāṇḍavarāgāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ bhujyatām iti paśūnāṃ vadhyatāṃ cāpi nāntas tatra sma dṛśyate
english: "Let dainties and condiments and relishes be prepared! Let them be eaten!" — and of the beasts being slaughtered no end could there be seen.

sanskrit: mattonmattapramuditaṃ pragītayuvatījanam mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhaśabdaiś ca manoramam abhūt tadā
english: Joyous with people drunk and rapt with delight, with young women singing, and with the sounds of drum and conch, the place was then a thing to charm the heart.

sanskrit: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ ceti divārātram avāritam taṃ mahotsavasaṃkāśam atihṛṣṭajanākulam kathayanti sma puruṣā nānādeśanivāsinaḥ
english: "Let it be given! Let it be eaten!" — thus, by day and night and without restraint, men dwelling in many lands told of that scene, like a great festival, thronged with people in the highest joy.

sanskrit: varṣitvā dhanadhārābhiḥ kāmai ratnair dhanais tathā vipāpmā bharataśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtārthaḥ prāviśat puram
english: Having rained down showers of wealth — of pleasures, jewels, and riches — the best of the Bhāratas, freed of sin and his purpose fulfilled, entered the city.

sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca pitāmahasya me yajñe dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ yad āścaryam abhūt kiṃ cit tad bhavān vaktum arhati
english: Janamejaya said: Whatever marvel there was in the sacrifice of my grandsire, the wise son of Dharma, that you ought to tell me.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śrūyatāṃ rājaśārdūla mahad āścaryam uttamam aśvamedhe mahāyajñe nivṛtte yad abhūd vibho
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Hear, O tiger among kings, of the great and surpassing marvel that came to pass, O mighty one, when the great horse-sacrifice was concluded.

sanskrit: tarpiteṣu dvijāgryeṣu jñātisaṃbandhibandhuṣu dīnāndhakṛpaṇe cāpi tadā bharatasattama
english: When the foremost brāhmaṇas had been satisfied, and the kinsmen, relations, and friends, and the poor, the blind, and the wretched too, O best of the Bhāratas —

sanskrit: ghuṣyamāṇe mahādāne dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata patatsu puṣpavarṣeṣu dharmarājasya mūrdhani
english: while the great gift was being proclaimed in all the quarters, O Bhārata, and showers of flowers were falling upon the head of the Dharma-king —

sanskrit: bilān niṣkramya nakulo rukmapārśvas tadānagha vajrāśanisamaṃ nādam amuñcata viśāṃ pate
english: a mongoose with one side of gold came forth from its hole, O sinless one, and uttered a cry like the crash of the thunderbolt, O lord of peoples.

sanskrit: sakṛd utsṛjya taṃ nādaṃ trāsayāno mṛgadvijān mānuṣaṃ vacanaṃ prāha dhṛṣṭo bilaśayo mahān
english: Having once sent forth that cry and terrified the beasts and birds, the great, bold dweller in the hole spoke in human speech.

sanskrit: saktuprasthena vo nāyaṃ yajñas tulyo narādhipāḥ uñchavṛtter vadānyasya kurukṣetranivāsinaḥ
english: "This sacrifice of yours, O kings, is not equal to the prastha-measure of barley-meal given by a generous man who lived by gleaning, dwelling at Kurukṣetra."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā nakulasya viśāṃ pate vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ sarve te brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ
english: Having heard that speech of the mongoose, O lord of peoples, all those bulls among brāhmaṇas were struck with the utmost amazement.

sanskrit: tataḥ sametya nakulaṃ paryapṛcchanta te dvijāḥ kutas tvaṃ samanuprāpto yajñaṃ sādhusamāgamam
english: Then those brāhmaṇas, gathering round the mongoose, questioned it: "Whence have you come to this sacrifice, this assembly of the good?

sanskrit: kiṃ balaṃ paramaṃ tubhyaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ kiṃ parāyaṇam kathaṃ bhavantaṃ vidyāma yo no yajñaṃ vigarhase
english: What is your supreme strength, what your learning, what your refuge? How are we to know you, who disparage our sacrifice —

sanskrit: avilupyāgamaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vidhijñair yājakaiḥ kṛtam yathāgamaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kartavyaṃ ca yathākṛtam
english: a sacrifice performed by priests who know the rules, without violating the whole of sacred tradition, according to tradition and according to law, and the duty done as it should be done?

sanskrit: pūjārhāḥ pūjitāś cātra vidhivac chāstracakṣuṣā mantrapūtaṃ hutaś cāgnir dattaṃ deyam amatsaram
english: Here those worthy of honour were honoured duly, with the eye of scripture; the fire was kindled with offerings purified by sacred verses; what was to be given was given without grudging.

sanskrit: tuṣṭā dvijarṣabhāś cātra dānair bahuvidhair api kṣatriyāś ca suyuddhena śrāddhair api pitāmahāḥ
english: And here the bulls among the twice-born were satisfied by gifts of many kinds, the kṣatriyas by good warfare, and the ancestors by the funeral offerings;

sanskrit: pālanena viśas tuṣṭāḥ kāmais tuṣṭā varastriyaḥ anukrośais tathā śūdrā dānaśeṣaiḥ pṛthagjanāḥ
english: the vaiśyas were satisfied by protection, the noble women by the granting of their desires, the śūdras by acts of compassion, and the common folk by the remnants of the gifts.

sanskrit: jñātisaṃbandhinas tuṣṭāḥ śaucena ca nṛpasya naḥ devā havirbhiḥ puṇyaiś ca rakṣaṇaiḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ
english: The kinsmen and relations were satisfied by the purity of our king, the gods by the holy oblations, and those who had come for shelter by his protection.

sanskrit: yad atra tathyaṃ tad brūhi satyasaṃdha dvijātiṣu yathāśrutaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ pṛṣṭo brāhmaṇakāmyayā
english: Tell us what is true in this matter, O you who are true to your word among the twice-born, as you have heard it and as you have seen it, being asked out of regard for the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: śraddheyavākyaḥ prājñas tvaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ bibharṣi ca samāgataś ca viprais tvaṃ tattvato vaktum arhasi
english: Your speech is worthy of trust, and you are wise; you bear a divine form, and you have come among the brāhmaṇas; you ought therefore to speak the truth."
